# Office OS — full agent brief

Local-first Mac workplace for assigning bounded outcomes to named AI employees, inspecting their progress and artifacts, resolving blockers, and resuming the organization across days.

## Current state

- Working private proof of concept for macOS; no public download or source access
- Intended as a one-time workplace purchase with optional employee subscriptions
- No price, checkout, employee marketplace, account system, or public distribution today
- Native release remains closed until Developer ID, notarization, stapling, Gatekeeper, checksum, and support gates pass

## Index

# Office OS

A local-first Mac workplace for named AI employees.

## What it is

- Durable employees with bounded responsibilities
- Inspectable local work and artifacts
- Explicit owner supervision and permissions
